summary: Stage 1 BitumenOps end-to-end testing complete. All 12 backend pytest cases pass (project CRUD, area shoelace math verified for 10x5 rectangle = 50 m^2 / 30 m perimeter, atomic per-project counter, MM/YY/XXXX format = 06/26/0001, cascade delete). Frontend Playwright covered all UX flows (dashboard load, project create/delete, workspace mount, all data-testids present, zoom in/out/reset to 100, status bar reflections, tool switching Krzyzyk/Raczka/Obszar, area drawing with live measurement, finish/cancel, multi-area counter increment 0001->0002, grid step change, back navigation, window.confirm delete). No backend or frontend bugs detected.

minor.issue: Does not 404 when project_id does not exist (returns empty list). Minor inconsistency vs other endpoints.
When payload is empty and project does not exist, returns 404 only after attempting update; cosmetic only.

issues: Dropdown options use role='menuitem' (Radix DropdownMenu) rather than role='option'. Not a bug, just worth noting for test writers. Consider adding data-testid='grid-step-option-<value>' for stable selection by automation.
Loading skeleton cards have no distinguishing data-testid; minor – tests should wait for actual project-card-{id}.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid to each grid-step DropdownMenuItem for easier automation (e.g. grid-step-option-1).
Optional: return 404 from GET /api/projects/{id}/areas when project does not exist for API consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly excludes Mongo _id via projection and _serialize().
Atomic counter via find_one_and_update with $inc is correct and race-safe.
Shoelace polygon_area and perimeter implementations correct (verified 10x5 = 50 m^2 / 30 m, 4x4 = 16/16, 8x6 = 48/28).
All endpoints use Pydantic models with proper validation (e.g. min_length=3 for points).
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via lib/api; no hardcoded URLs spotted.
Workspace.js useEffect dep array intentionally suppresses lint for finishArea closure – acceptable but consider useCallback to avoid stale closures.
All required data-testids present and correct.
seed_data_creation: Test projects created during E2E were cleaned up via API after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are at /app/backend/tests/test_bitumen_api.py and rely on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend dropdown options for grid-step use role='menuitem' (Radix DropdownMenu); use get_by_text('1 m', exact=True) or add explicit testids. Dashboard renders 6 skeleton placeholders while loading – wait for project-card-{id} testid before asserting. window.confirm dialogs must be auto-accepted via page.on('dialog'). Canvas zoomToScale = 50 px/m at 100% (200px = 8m). Area IDs are MM/YY/XXXX in UTC.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Two minor first-iteration test script issues were resolved during testing: (1) initial selector [role='option'] did not match because Radix DropdownMenu uses role='menuitem'; (2) needed to wait for actual project-card-{id} testid after back nav because the dashboard renders 6 skeleton cards on load – both were test-side adjustments, not application bugs.
